The rifle's average time-to-kill is about 0.35 seconds, from 11 enemy kills I measured in a 60-second playtest.

I scripted one run with event recording on. The player used the rifle and auto-aimed and fired at the nearest enemy. The run covered wave 1 (5 enemies) and wave 2 (8 enemies). The player was killed at about 52 seconds, so the last 8 seconds had no kills. For each enemy I took the time from the first recorded `hit` on it to its `kill` event.

- **Per-enemy times:** they ran from 0.20 to 0.62 seconds. That is consistent with the rifle's stats: 25 damage per shot at 600 rounds per minute means a 100-health enemy dies in about 4 shots, roughly 0.3 seconds.
- **Outlier left out:** one kill (EnemyCharacter_11) showed 7.7 seconds because a stray early shot hit it while the aim was still swinging between targets. Its real engagement was a hit at 43.99 seconds and a kill at 44.26 seconds. Counting that outlier as a 7.7-second kill would raise the average to 0.96 seconds.
- **Other enemy types:** I didn't check whether wave 2 included sprinters or brutes, so the 11 kills may mix enemy types.

I restarted a fresh play session at the end, so the game is running.

ANSWER: 0.35

The rifle's average time-to-kill against standard enemies was about 0.31 seconds, from two player kills in a 70-second playtest with events recorded.

I defined time-to-kill as the time from the first rifle hit on an enemy to its `kill` event.

| Enemy | First hit (s) | Kill (s) | Time-to-kill (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| EnemyCharacter_0 | 10.707 | 11.013 | 0.305 |
| EnemyCharacter_3 | 17.759 | 18.075 | 0.316 |

- **Weapon:** every recorded hit was the Rifle for 25 damage, and a standard enemy has 100 health, so a kill takes 4 hits.
- **Fire rate:** shots land about 0.1 seconds apart, which gives the 0.3 second figure.
- **Sample size:** the run was meant to cover 60 seconds, but only two enemies were killed in it. I fired in bursts after aiming at the nearest enemy, and many shots missed, so the average rests on those two kills.
- **God mode:** I used `god` mode so the player survived the full run. That does not affect the rifle's time-to-kill.

ANSWER: 0.31
